purpose: Edit schema-based rich text with bold, italic, lists, links and undo/redo using a mature text editing engine.
behaviorProvider: Tiptap 3.32.1 / ProseMirror with limited StarterKit schema; Base UI Toolbar and shared Modal/TextInput/Button.

component: schema validation and JSON state bridge
host: safe downstream rendering and document migration

requirements.statement: Validate initial and controlled JSON with the installed editor schema. Require a doc root; reject unsupported nodes, invalid nesting and unsafe link destinations. Accepted output is normalized editor JSON.

Delegate editing, selection, composition, clipboard schema parsing and history to Tiptap/ProseMirror. Provide bold, italic, bullet-list, numbered-list, link, undo and redo commands through shared buttons.

Initialize uncontrolled content from defaultValue once. Emit document JSON on editor updates. For controlled value, reconcile mismatched editor content without emitting an update or adding the replacement to history.
Use Base UI Toolbar keyboard navigation and expose active formatting through aria-pressed. Mouse toolbar activation preserves the editor selection and commands focus the editor.

Disable automatic linkification and click navigation in the editing surface. Accept HTTP(S), mailto and relative links; reject control characters and other protocols. The dialog preserves its draft on invalid input; empty input removes the selected link.

Use Field control identity, disabled, required, invalid and description associations. Render the editing surface as a multiline textbox; a visible standalone label supplies aria-labelledby when no explicit label association is supplied.
Disabled and readOnly make the editor noneditable and disable formatting actions. Disabled removes the surface from sequential keyboard focus and excludes the named hidden input from form submission.

When name is present, submit one hidden JSON string, optionally associated with the supplied form. Required is announced on the editor; a hidden input does not implement native nonempty-content validation.

Feed accepted document changes back to value. External replacements can reposition selection; coordinate revisions and persistence outside the editor rather than treating this as a collaborative document protocol.
Validate meaningful document content before submission and validate/sanitize downstream rendering according to the application. The link policy and restricted schema are not a general HTML sanitizer.
Use input group tokens for editor presentation and preserve nested toolbar Button and Modal token ownership.

limitations: No tables, headings, media, file upload, comments, collaborative editing or raw HTML value API.
Editor initializes on the client; server-rendered output does not contain an interactive ProseMirror editor.
Toolbar and link-dialog copy is currently English. The host must supply a meaningful editor name.
